name: Pool Deck Chili Cheese Dog & Grilled Bratwurst with Sauerkraut (Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Pete's Boiler Bites / Disney Magic · Duck-In Diner
whyItWorks: A plain all-beef hot dog in a white bun is tolerable in remission, but topping it with bean chili or sauerkraut triggers immediate bloating and urgency.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering a hot dog poolside, order a plain all-beef frankfurter in a white bun with yellow mustard or ketchup only—strictly no chili, no raw onions, and no sauerkraut.
watchOuts: Whole kidney beans and chili spice in chili topping
